description: Makes task-worktree root selection a machine-level resolution policy and removes the per-command root requirement from adopter workflow instructions.
delta: Codex worktree access now directs operators to the read-only `meridian setup --check` plan and one explicitly consented `meridian setup --apply`; Claude Code needs no host configuration. Bounded lifecycle, implementation, review, and remediation commands omit `--worktree-root` and rely on the shared resolver while preserving the explicit option for legacy cleanup. Worktree lifecycle documentation records the precedence order, default, and rule that old worktrees remain in place.
verification: upgrade installs only the bumped managed capability regions and preserves project-owned text
adopter workflow commands use the resolved root while retaining an explicit old-root cleanup path
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
